fact: The article reports that recruitment has opened for the Digital Health Company Ltd, a public company under the Ministry of Health and Wellness charged with managing and overseeing the eHealth project, with the ministry's Permanent Secretary as Officer in Charge and no CEO yet, and that training of hospital staff for One Patient, One Record has begun at Flacq hospital and is to extend to other hospitals.
title: Ile Maurice: La transformation numérique via le projet eHealth prend forme
